address: 306 Changsheng Road, Gushan District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan
bio: Cratain is a portmanteau of Tasmania’s Cradle Mountain, which the owner once climbed. He draws a parallel between his restaurant and mountaineering, using the pristine white space as a blank canvas for dishes finessed with well-honed European techniques. He offers a set menu with a choice of mains, alongside optional seasonal specialities. Meat, chargrilled or pan-seared, is the main event, but the pasta is also a highlight.
